title: Speed envelope and alert scoring
text: Sustained speed above the posted or fleet envelope raises kinetic energy and lengthens stopping distance. Score each ADAS event from vehicle speed, with a higher band above 60 km/h. Treat speeding as a primary risk factor when it co-occurs with dense traffic or known crash corridors.

title: Headway warning (cas_hmw)
text: cas_hmw is a collision-avoidance headway event. Repeated HMW with short following distance is a leading precursor of rear-end collisions. Increase following distance and review camera clips after a cluster of high brake events.

title: Lane departure warning (cas_ldw)
text: cas_ldw fires when the vehicle crosses a lane marking without a corresponding turn signal or road curvature change. High steering variance with LDW is consistent with weaving or distraction. Pull the vehicle for a lane-discipline review before the next trip.

title: Forward collision warning (cas_fcw)
text: cas_fcw is the most severe CAS code in this corpus. Combine it with the speed-band score: FCW above 60 km/h is a coaching event, not a dashboard curiosity. Slow, increase gap, and avoid overtaking.

title: Driver monitoring stream
text: Treat DMS cues (inattention, heading wander after long duty hours) as a second stream, not a biometric lab. Schedule a rest break and check hours-of-service compliance.

title: Historical hotspots
text: When live CAS activity occurs inside a mapped high-crash zone, treat the two signals together rather than as independent alerts. Slow, increase gap, and avoid overtaking.

title: Incident narrative rules
text: Human-readable incident summaries must only cite causes supported by telemetry features or retrieved guideline sections. Do not invent weather, intoxication, biometrics, or mechanical failures that are not in the evidence.

title: Adaptive filtering
text: When a fault-severity event is on the board, suppress informational chatter. Safety desks cannot act on every LDW equally. Rank by severity, then by speed-band alert score, then by session risk.
